# Southwest Iowa Hedge (Williams Creek Farms, LLC)

> Premium Osage Orange hedge fence posts for permanent fencing and traditional archery bow stave logs. Fresh cut in Southwest Iowa near Grant, Iowa, serving Iowa, Missouri, and Nebraska. Pickup at the farm; payment is not due until pickup.

## Pages

- [Hedge Posts (home)](https://williamscreekfarms.com/): Product lineup and current pricing for premium and regular line/corner posts, last year's posts, and bow stave logs
- [Order Now](https://williamscreekfarms.com/order-now): Order form with quantities, volume discount (10% over 100 posts), and optional 10% deposit
- [FAQ](https://williamscreekfarms.com/faq): Common questions about durability, choosing posts, ordering, pickup, delivery, and bow staves
- [Osage Bow Staves](https://williamscreekfarms.com/osage-bow-staves): Hand-selected Osage Orange logs for traditional bowyers
- [Contact](https://williamscreekfarms.com/contact): Contact form; phone 712-254-3999

## Key facts

- All fence posts are 9 ft long, fresh cut for easy nailing and stapling
- Hedge (Osage Orange) posts commonly last 50+ years in the ground with no treatment
- Pickup at the farm: 1100 Apple Ave, Grant, Iowa; delivery available at $2/mile one way; no shipping
